title: Massive News for Alphabet Stock and Constellation Energy Stock Investors | GOOG Stock | CEG Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc covers Google's $4.3B, 20-year power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy for 890 MW of nuclear (via upgrades at existing sites, no new build required), plus a separate 15-year deal for another 2.7 GW. He places it in the hyperscaler nuclear wave: Amazon signed with Constellation in January, Microsoft signed a 20-year deal in 2024 tied to the Three Mile Island restart by 2028, while Meta chose Vistra. His macro frame: data-center power demand is the binding constraint on AI buildout (alongside memory shortages), and he estimates just five companies will spend ~$850B in capex in 2026, exceeding $1T in 2027. CEG popped 12% on the news but is still down 15% YTD (though up 691% over five years); it trades at a forward P/E of 22.5x, roughly its average since 2024. His updated DCF gives a $387 fair value versus ~$300 market, implying ~30% upside over 12–18 months. Call: CEG BUY with low conviction — he views Constellation as a commodity power provider and can't yet identify what differentiates one nuclear supplier from another in hyperscalers' eyes. First tracked call on CEG; no flip.
